claims.summary: Characteristic zero, lambda=3/2. For the product of F far and n near clusters, rows (1+s_i/S)^(-3/2)(1+t_j S)^(-3/2), the lowest total-degree part of the Pluecker coordinate on the extreme window [-(F-1), Fn-F] is C Vand(s)^n Vand(t)^(F^2), and on [-(Fn-n), n-1] it is C' Vand(s)^(n^2) Vand(t)^F, with nonzero constants.
claims.assessment: Conjecture. Symbolic at 2x2; at 2x3 and 3x2 the unique fitting Vandermonde exponents at six random points are the conjectured ones; trivially true for F=1. Middle windows have lower-degree initial forms that are not Vandermonde products.
claims.rationale: Closed-form valuations of the extreme product windows, a step towards the window rule of caterpillar components.
